meta.name: Parineeta
meta.description:
A chance meeting at a train station after years apart reignites old emotions between Lalita and Shekhar, sparking a tumultuous journey of love, jealousy, and complex bonds. Based on the timeless novel by Sarat Chandra Chattopadhyay, Parineeta, streaming from 15 August, only on hoichoi.

Returning Series · First aired 15 Aug 2024 · IN · Language: Bengali
